messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER — Sev 2 — LYNX (customer: lynx.inc) VPC inference endpoints degraded in us-west-2. Error rate on dp-lynx-02 rising to 18%. Paging oncall: @sam_h
sam_h: Acknowledged. Investigating now. Starting triage: metric checks + tenant isolation.
sam_h: Quick check: dp-lynx-02 shows noisy tenant 0x7c4 causing KV cache evictions and high memory churn. Rolling isolation plan: move noisy workload to spare pool, apply tenant rate-limit.
maya_infra: I can provision spare nodes, ETA ~8m. Preparing pool warmup and eviction commands:
```
# move tenant
rbctl tenant-evict --tenant=0x7c4 --from=dp-lynx-02 --to=dp-spare-01
rbctl set-rate-limit --tenant=0x7c4 --rate=50rps
```
josh_sre: +1 to eviction. Also suggest prefix-KV flush to reduce memory pressure; temporarily drop batching on dp-lynx-02 (batch_size=8) to lower tail latency.
emily_cs: Notifying Lynx CSM and support. CSM Anita is on the call — asking for immediate ETA and if customer wants a bridge. Contract: Lynx has 99.9% uptime on dedicated pool.
sam_h: Executing eviction now. Will watch health and error-rate graphs.
IncidentBot: ACTION — tenant 0x7c4 evicted to dp-spare-01 — completed at 1729010200
sam_h: Metrics improving: error rate down to 3%, 95th latency back to baseline. Keeping monitors at high sensitivity for 30m.
emily_cs: Confirmed with Lynx engineer (Anita) — they observed inbound 429s and server errors stop after eviction. They reported impacted window 14:12–14:45 UTC and asked about credits.
lex_legal: For credits, we need exact impacted duration and resource units consumed. Typical precedent: pro-rated monthly committed capacity credits; recommend proposing 5% credit of monthly reserved fee for the window. I'll draft the legal language for CSM review.
josh_sre: RCA bullet points so far: root cause = noisy tenant workload with misconfigured batching and large KV working set; contributing = lack of tenant-level soft throttling and missing early admission control on dp-lynx-02.
sam_h: Mitigations implemented: tenant eviction to spare pool, set tenant rate-limit, prefix-KV flush, reduced batch size. Next steps: add tenant admission-control rule and alert for KV eviction rate.
emily_cs: I'll prep the executive-facing summary and coordinate with Anita on whether Lynx wants a follow-up call. Proposed audience: CTO + Ops lead + CSM.
opsbot: Handoff: incident being assigned to night oncall @tom_n for RCA/credits follow-up.
sam_h: Passing ownership to @tom_n — monitoring continues.
tom_n: Acknowledged. I'll own the post-incident RCA draft and coordinate credit calculation with @lex_legal and @emily_cs. Target timeline: initial exec note in 2 hours, full RCA within 72 hours.
sam_h: Thanks team :thumbsup:
